data.name: The Prey’s Game
data.detailed_description:
Make sure you survive till tomorrow before you fall in love.

Welcome to The Prey’s Game—where there is no salvation, only the choice of with whom you will sink.

▌ A Different Definition of "Love"

If love is round-the-clock surveillance...

If love is meticulous calculation...

If love is violent possession...

If love is eternal preservation...

If love is a merciless trial...

If love is merciful imprisonment...

— Would you still dare to want it?

▌ This Is Your Story

You are a gambler.

You bet that beauty can be exchanged for a future, that wisdom can win survival, and that by navigating between the six most dangerous men, you won't be the one to lose it all.

Your wagers are your own heart, and the seven days of life you have left.

▌ Meet Them

  • The Shadow · "Morley":​ "They all say I'm your shadow, but at least a shadow can cling openly to the ground. What am I? I'm the filth on your sole that you can never scrape off."

  • The Perfect Heir · Lucien:​ "Marry me. The title of Mrs. Lu, half my fortune, and... all of my sins—I'll share them all with you. Fair, isn't it? You want fame and fortune; I want you. We both get what we desire most."

  • The Two-Faced Sheriff · Albarn:​ "Put on the handcuffs and be my prisoner. Or, pick up the gun and be my accomplice."

  • The Arms Fanatic · Leon:​ "My love is fucking dynamite! We either soar to heaven together or burn in hell together!"

  • The Gentle Artist · Cecil:​ "Death is not the end, my dear—it's a freeze-frame. And I... I just want to help you freeze at your most beautiful moment."

  • The Merciful Face, The Ruthless Heart · Silas:​ "All my greed, hatred, delusion, and obsession are tied to you alone. Tell me, should I enshrine you upon a sacred altar, or... drag you down into the mortal dust to fall with me?"

▌ In the End, Will You...

Heal a twisted soul?

Conquer a dark empire?

Dance with the shadows for the rest of your life?

Or... turn them all into the steps leading to your throne?

Love is a deadly game, and you are the dealer.

The Prey’s Game—is your heart ready?

data.short_description: "The Prey’s Game" is a dark romantic visual novel where you, a revenge-driven heroine, must survive and manipulate six dangerous, obsessive men. Every choice determines if you end as prey or hunter. Navigate a web of lethal attraction with over 30 possible endings.

  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 集成显卡即可，无需独立显卡
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature themes and content suitable for adult players only, primarily including:

Violence and Blood: Contains descriptions and visual implications of murder, injury, kidnapping, and physical abuse. Some plot points involve depictions of physical harm inflicted on characters.

Sexual Content: Contains strong sexual innuendo, seductive scenarios, and depictions of sexual control and power dynamics. The story involves non-consensual intimate contact based on coercion, deception, or power imbalance, but does not include direct depictions of sexual acts or explicit pornographic imagery.

Intense Psychological and Emotional Abuse: Core themes revolve around morbidly obsessive love, psychological manipulation, forced confinement, stalking, threats, and emotional control. Character relationships are oppressive, manipulative, and dangerous.


All aforementioned content serves to develop characters, advance the dark romantic narrative, and create tension, and is not the core purpose of the game. Players are advised to exercise discretion based on their personal sensitivity to these themes.
